episodes.name: School Bus Scuffle
episodes.overviewEn: Krypto embarks on a high-flying chase that creates major mayhem for a bus driver on his way to school.

episodes.name: Halloween Havoc
episodes.overviewEn: When a black cat crosses Krypto's path, he's determined to catch it before Halloween night is over!

episodes.name: Package Pandemonium
episodes.overviewEn: Krypto smells something special in a holiday package, and in his eagerness to grab the gift he makes a mess of Metropolis's festivities.

episodes.name: Space Busted!
episodes.overviewEn: Supergirl takes Krypto the Superdog on an adventure into space!  Can he save the aliens he meets along the way?

episodes.name: Robo-Pal⁩
episodes.overviewEn: Lex Luthor deploys a robo-dog to hunt Superman and Supergirl, but the mission unravels when Krypto and the machine become best friends.

episodes.name: Tales of Puppy Past
episodes.overviewEn: A holiday scrapbook sends Superman and Supergirl reminiscing about puppy Krypto's earliest Christmases on Earth.
